name: Iranamadu Water Sports
description: Iranamadu Water Sports is a unique adventure park nestled in the Northern Province, offering thrilling water sports and exciting activities amidst lush greenery and scenic views. Experience kayaking, rafting, and swimming in pristine waters surrounded by nature's beauty.
monsoon_note: Oct–Jan NE monsoon; check roads after rain

name: Kilinochchi Cycling Route
description: The Kilinochchi Cycling Route, an adventurous park in the Kilinochchi district of Sri Lanka, offers cyclists scenic routes through lush greenery and alongside serene rivers. It’s a popular spot for bird watchers and picnickers, attracting tourists interested in nature and outdoor activities. Historically, the area was part of the Jaffna Kingdom under the Kingdom of Ceylon, though specific details of its founding or past rulers are unknown. Today, it serves as a rejuvenating escape for those seeking natural beauty and relaxation.

name: Elephant Pass Trek
description: The Elephant Pass Trek, nestled in the heart of the Eastern Province, offers hikers an adventurous journey through dense jungle landscapes. This area was once a strategic passageway used by ancient armies, its rugged terrain now a testament to the region's rich military history. Today, visitors can explore this path, spotting wildlife along the way, including elephants, leopards, and various bird species. Notable for its untouched natural beauty and historical significance, the trek attracts nature lovers and history buffs alike, offering a unique glimpse into Sri Lanka's past.
monsoon_note: Oct–Jan NE monsoon; check roads after rain
